name: create_ts_discriminated_union
description: Models shapes as a discriminated union with an exhaustive area()
prompts: Create shapes.ts exporting: a discriminated union type Shape with three variants discriminated by a `kind` field - {kind: 'circle', radius: number}, {kind: 'rect', width: number, height: number}, and {kind: 'triangle', base: number, height: number} - and a function area(shape: Shape): number returning pi*r^2 for circles, width*height for rects, and base*height/2 for triangles. The switch over kind must be exhaustive under `tsc --strict` (use a never-typed default so adding a fourth variant later becomes a compile error), and passing an object with an unknown kind must be a type error.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit shapes.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build shapes.ts
node behavior_test.js
